Medical.Net offline-first synchronisation: hybrid logical clocks, per-type conflict policies (append-only clinical data, last-writer-wins, server-wins), a sync server over any store, and a SQLite client store with HTTP or in-process transport — for ward-round apps that keep working without a networ…

Medical.Net hospital information system core: multi-tenant EF Core model and services for registration and queues, outpatient (SOAP, ICD-10), inpatient bed management, pharmacy (FEFO stock, interaction / allergy / renal checks), laboratory (critical values, HL7 ORM / ORU), radiology (accession, rep…
IEC 61850: SCL (ICD/CID/SCD) parsing, logical-node data model, GOOSE and Sampled Values (9-2LE) frame encoding/decoding with ASN.1 BER, MMS object references.
Power quality and harmonics: FFT, THD/TDD, IEEE 519 and IEC 61000 limits, harmonic load flow and frequency scan, resonance detection, passive filter design, flicker and unbalance.

Blazor components for Electrical.Net: single-line diagram with power-flow overlay, line/bar charts, heatmap, phasor diagram, TCC (protection) chart, gauge, KPI card and raw SVG host. Themed with the --eln-* CSS variables.
State estimation: weighted least squares AC estimator with sparse gain matrix, measurement model (V, P, Q, flows, PMU), observability, chi-square and largest-normalized-residual bad-data detection.

Circuit simulation: modified nodal analysis (DC operating point, AC phasor sweep, transient with companion models), SPICE-like netlists, R/L/C, sources, diodes, switches, transformers, three-phase circuits.
Simulation: quasi-static time-series (QSTS) simulation over load/PV profiles, Monte-Carlo reliability (sequential), scenario management and event timelines.
Forecasting: short-term load forecasting (Holt-Winters, regression with weather features, k-NN similar day), solar and wind power forecasting, error metrics and synthetic load profiles.

Power system stability: transient stability (classical and two-axis models, RK4), critical clearing time, small-signal eigen-analysis, voltage stability (continuation power flow, PV/QV curves, L-index), frequency response.
Visualization: automatic single-line diagram layout and SVG rendering with power-flow overlays, SVG charts (line, bar, heatmap, phasor, TCC log-log), PNG encoder, color ramps.
Cloud: study job runner with JSON contracts, ASP.NET Core minimal API endpoints (MapElectricalApi) for power flow, short circuit and contingency, and multi-tenant scenario storage abstractions.

Protection engineering: IEC 60255 / IEEE C37.112 inverse-time overcurrent curves, relay coordination, distance protection zones, differential protection, fuses, breaker duty and IEEE 1584 arc-flash incident energy.
Electrical.Net core: complex/sparse linear algebra, per-unit system, phasors and symmetrical components, power network model, Y-bus, MATPOWER I/O, IEEE test cases, DI and event bus.
High-performance computing: parallel batch and Monte-Carlo power flow, probabilistic load flow, SIMD kernels and Rust native acceleration with managed fallback.
SCADA: Modbus TCP client/server and codec, tag database, alarm management (ISA-18.2 states), historian with deadband compression, RTU simulator, IEC 60870-5-104 APDU codec.

AI for power systems: LLM grid-operator agent with tool calling (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, Ollama, offline), anomaly detection, fault classification, and reinforcement-learning environments for Volt/VAR control.

Renewable energy: solar PV (single-diode, irradiance and temperature models, MPPT), wind turbines (power curves, Weibull energy yield), battery energy storage, inverters with grid codes, hosting capacity.

AC/DC power flow for Electrical.Net: sparse Newton–Raphson, Gauss–Seidel, fast-decoupled (XB), DC, backward/forward sweep for radial feeders, Q-limit enforcement, ZIP loads, N-1 contingency screening, PTDF/LODF sensitivities.
GIS for grids: GeoJSON export/import of networks, Web Mercator projection, line length from geometry, nearest-asset search, SVG map rendering and outage areas.

dotnet new templates for Electrical.Net: power-system study console, Blazor grid dashboard, Avalonia single-line viewer, SCADA edge gateway (Modbus TCP + alarms) and power-system REST API. Made by Gravicode Studios, led by Kang Fadhil.
IEC CIM / CGMES: RDF/XML import and export of power networks (IEC 61970-301 equipment and topology), mapping to the Electrical.Net network model.

Smart grid: demand response, EV charging scheduling, microgrid energy management, virtual power plant aggregation, Volt/VAR optimization, DERMS, feeder reconfiguration and reliability indices (SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI/ENS).

Short-circuit analysis per IEC 60909 / ANSI: three-phase, single-line-to-ground, line-to-line and double-line-to-ground faults via sequence networks and Z-bus, peak (ip) and breaking currents, fault contributions.
Digital twin: live grid twin synchronised from SCADA measurements via state estimation, what-if simulation, asset health and explained alarms.
Optimization: economic dispatch, DC optimal power flow (interior-point QP), security-constrained dispatch, unit commitment, optimal capacitor placement and loss minimization.

Electrical.Net command-line tool (eln): power flow, N-1 contingency, short circuit, stability, harmonics, protection, dispatch/OPF, state estimation, forecasting, probabilistic load flow, single-line diagrams, GeoJSON/CIM/MATPOWER conversion, Modbus RTU simulator, REST API server and the AI grid ag…
